title: Python-free openWakeWord hot-word detection in Bun
description: effect-pi needs wake-word detection with no Python runtime, no Python subprocess, and no alternative engine fallback. The solution must run in Bun and integrate with existing PulseAudio recording stream.
design: Use openWakeWord models with a Bun-compatible JavaScript runtime. Implement the full inference path in TypeScript/Effect: 16k mono PCM chunking, melspectrogram inference, embedding inference, wakeword score inference, and trigger logic. Keep this as a dedicated wakeword service with clear input/output contracts so the rest of the pipeline consumes trigger events only.
acceptance_criteria: A Bun-only wake-word detector is available in the codebase, wired to live microphone audio, and can emit trigger events for configured wake words. No Python dependency is required at runtime. A manual CLI verification path and automated tests exist. bun run gate passes.
notes: Implemented initial end-to-end wakeword stack: new src/wakeword modules for ONNX session loading, streaming inference pipeline, trigger machine, and live PulseAudio orchestration; CLI wakeword command with telemetry and trigger output; fixture/unit/integration tests; docs + asset manifest layout. Current runtime validation works, but real detection is blocked locally until actual ONNX model files and onnxruntime-web package are available in this sandboxed environment.
close_reason: Delivered: Bun-only openWakeWord detection/training/tuning pipeline with live PulseAudio integration, strict real-ONNX runtime validation, automated trigger tuning, tests/docs, and XDG-based runtime data/config cleanup.

title: Pin Bun-compatible runtime and openWakeWord model assets
description: Lock the exact inference runtime and model artifact set needed for Python-free openWakeWord execution in Bun.
design: Select and pin the Bun-compatible ONNX runtime package and define a stable local model asset layout for melspectrogram, embedding, and wakeword models. Add startup validation so missing or incompatible model files fail fast with actionable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Dependencies and model versions are pinned. Required model files are discoverable from the app. Startup validation reports clear errors for missing assets and succeeds when assets are present.
notes: Added required feature model paths in assets/openwakeword: melspectrogram.onnx and embedding_model.onnx now exist (placeholder files in repo). Also added native TypeScript fallback feature extractor path in src/wakeword/onnx.ts so training/inference can proceed in offline/no-onnxruntime environments with JSON wakeword models.
close_reason: Done: pinned onnxruntime-web@1.22.0, enforced real ONNX feature models, removed fallback feature path, added strict asset validation and checksum-based installer, and moved runtime assets to XDG data/config layout.

title: Implement openWakeWord inference pipeline service in TypeScript
description: Build the core detector service that transforms live PCM frames into wake-word scores without Python.
design: Implement a stateful Effect service for the model pipeline: 80ms PCM frame intake, melspectrogram inference and transform, mel-frame buffering, embedding-window inference, embedding buffering, and wakeword score inference. Expose a clear API that consumes PCM chunks and returns per-model scores.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid 16k mono PCM input chunks, the service emits numeric wake-word scores continuously. Buffer/window logic is deterministic and resilient to stream boundaries.
close_reason: Done: implemented deterministic TypeScript wakeword inference pipeline for PCM chunking, melspectrogram, embedding windows, and continuous scoring.

title: Add wake-word trigger state machine
description: Convert raw per-frame scores into reliable trigger events suitable for assistant activation.
design: Implement configurable trigger logic with score thresholding, smoothing/debounce, refractory cooldown, and event emission metadata (timestamp, model, score). Keep logic independent from audio transport so it can be unit tested.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger logic suppresses noisy score spikes and emits stable trigger events only when configured criteria are met. Cooldown prevents duplicate rapid-fire triggers.
close_reason: Done: added wakeword trigger state machine with smoothing, thresholding, consecutive-frame logic, and cooldown to suppress noise spikes.

title: Wire wake-word detector to live PulseAudio stream
description: Integrate detector runtime with existing recording stream so live microphone audio feeds wake-word scoring.
design: Create runtime orchestration that consumes Uint8Array PCM chunks from PulseAudio stream, normalizes chunk boundaries to detector frame requirements, and forwards scores/triggers through Effect streams/queues.
acceptance_criteria: On a machine with PulseAudio, live microphone audio reaches the detector continuously and produces score updates without crashes or resource leaks.
close_reason: Done: wired live PulseAudio stream into wakeword runtime; telemetry and trigger flow verified in live command runs.

title: Expose wake-word CLI command for manual verification
description: Add a CLI path to run live detection and inspect scores/triggers during local testing.
design: Extend effect/cli command tree with a wakeword subcommand that starts detector runtime, prints score snapshots and trigger events, and supports key config flags (duration, threshold, model selection, debug verbosity).
acceptance_criteria: bun run cli -- wakeword executes end-to-end detection, prints live telemetry, and clearly reports trigger events.
notes: Adjusted `wakeword-train` positive-sample collection to be speech-activated (RMS threshold + consecutive active chunks + pre-roll). It now waits for user speech before starting each positive clip and auto-retries when no speech is detected (`--max-wait-seconds`, `--retry-limit`, `--speech-rms`, `--speech-chunks`, `--pre-roll-ms`).
close_reason: Done: delivered wakeword CLI plus training and tuning commands, model/source diagnostics, and auto-load of persisted tuning snapshots.

title: Add fixture and integration tests for wake-word detection
description: Prove detector behavior with automated tests across model pipeline, trigger logic, and live integration boundaries.
design: Add deterministic tests for buffering and trigger logic using fixture PCM input, plus a live integration smoke test that validates startup and score flow when PulseAudio is present.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover core detector behavior, include deterministic fixture-based assertions, and pass under bun test. Live-only tests skip gracefully when runtime prerequisites are unavailable.
close_reason: Done: added wakeword pipeline/trigger/assets/training/live tests and validated with bun test + gate.

title: Document wake-word configuration and operator workflow
description: Capture how to run, tune, and verify wake-word detection in development and local ops.
design: Document required audio assumptions, model asset expectations, CLI usage, threshold tuning guidance, and troubleshooting steps. Update architecture and QA docs with wakeword lifecycle and verification commands.
acceptance_criteria: Docs explain setup, execution, validation, and tuning clearly enough for a new contributor to run wake-word detection and reproduce verification locally.
close_reason: Done: updated architecture and QA docs with wakeword setup, runtime requirements, training/tuning workflow, and verification commands.

title: Recording Indicator For Assistant
description: Show an always-visible recording state indicator for effect-pi assistant so users know when PTT or wakeword dictation is actively capturing audio. Integrate with existing Niri + Quickshell setup and keep native dependencies minimal.
notes: Epic created from runtime feedback: need explicit recording indicator while assistant captures audio.

title: Emit assistant recording state file
description: Add runtime state emission from effect-pi assistant for PTT and wakeword capture lifecycle. Write JSON state under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/effect-pi/recording.json with active flag, mode, startedAt and updatedAt so external UI (Quickshell) can poll it.
acceptance_criteria: State file is created on assistant startup; transitions to active on capture start and inactive on capture stop; file content is valid JSON and reflects mode: ptt-transcribe, ptt-translate, wakeword.
notes: Starting implementation in effect-pi codebase: emit runtime recording state file for PTT and wakeword captures.
close_reason: Implemented in effect-pi: assistant now writes runtime recording state to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/effect-pi/recording.json and updates mode transitions for wakeword/PTT capture lifecycle.

title: Add recording indicator widget in Quickshell
description: Implement a Quickshell widget that watches effect-pi recording state file and displays a red recording icon when active. Reuse existing widget style and polling pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Widget appears in bar; shows hidden when inactive and visible/blinking when active; tooltip includes current mode.

title: Optional transient OSD for recording start/stop
description: Add optional swayosd custom-message notifications on recording start/stop for immediate feedback. Keep disabled by default and configurable via env var.
acceptance_criteria: When enabled, start and stop events show swayosd messages; failures do not break recording pipeline.

title: Document recording indicator integration
description: Document runtime state file contract and integration steps for Niri/Quickshell users, including troubleshooting and mode examples.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture/docs updated with file path, JSON schema, and expected lifecycle transitions; includes testing checklist.

title: Add Effect CLI record command
description: Add bun run cli entrypoint using effect/unstable/cli with record subcommand for manual PulseAudio recording verification.
close_reason: Implemented CLI record command and validated via bun run cli + gate

title: Wayland PTT + Text Injection Spike
description: Investigate end-to-end feasibility on Wayland for: (1) global push-to-talk capture using xdg-desktop-portal, and (2) typing recognized text into the focused app using wtype.
design: Use xdg-desktop-portal GlobalShortcuts for capturing a user-approved PTT accelerator. For output, invoke wtype as an external helper to type text into the focused window (Wayland). No STT integration in this epic; only trigger + output feasibility.
acceptance_criteria: We can register a PTT shortcut and observe activations while effect-pi is unfocused. We can invoke wtype from Bun and observe text being entered into a focused app (e.g. Slack). Provide a manual CLI command(s) to validate both. Document compositor/desktop prerequisites and limitations.
close_reason: Spike commands and docs implemented for portal PTT capture and wtype typing feasibility

title: Spike: Capture push-to-talk via xdg-desktop-portal GlobalShortcuts
description: Add a minimal Bun/Effect proof-of-concept that registers a global shortcut using org.freedesktop.portal.GlobalShortcuts and prints activation events.
design: Implement a small portal client (D-Bus) or spawn system tools (busctl/gdbus) behind an Effect service. Provide a CLI command (e.g. bun run cli -- ptt-portal) that registers a shortcut, waits, and logs activations until Ctrl+C.
acceptance_criteria: Running the CLI command prompts the user to grant the shortcut, then activations are logged when pressed even when another app is focused. Clear error shown when portal/backend not supported.
close_reason: Implemented ptt-portal spike command with busctl GlobalShortcuts setup and monitor flow

title: Spike: Type text via wtype
description: Add a Bun/Effect proof-of-concept that invokes wtype to type provided text into the currently focused app.
design: Implement a small module that spawns wtype with proper escaping and error handling. Provide a CLI command (e.g. bun run cli -- type --text 'hello').
acceptance_criteria: With wtype installed and a text field focused, running the CLI command types the provided text. Clear error shown when wtype is missing.
close_reason: Implemented wtype typing spike command with clear runtime error handling

title: Docs: Wayland PTT + wtype prerequisites
description: Document required packages, portal backend availability, and compositor limitations for global shortcuts + wtype.
design: Add a short doc section in docs/ (or existing QA/architecture doc) listing: needed portal interface versions, required desktop support, how to install wtype, and known compositor constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Docs provide enough steps to reproduce both spikes on a fresh system.
close_reason: Added Wayland spike prerequisites and manual validation docs

title: Auto-detect Wayland/X11 text injection backend
description: Ensure text injection command auto-detects session type and chooses compatible backend.
design: Detect session via XDG_SESSION_TYPE/WAYLAND_DISPLAY/DISPLAY. Use wtype on Wayland and xdotool on X11, with fallback to alternate backend when primary backend cannot be used.
acceptance_criteria: `bun run cli -- type --text ...` selects backend automatically on Wayland and X11, with clear errors when required tools are unavailable.
close_reason: Implemented session detection, backend auto-selection, fallback logic, docs updates, and tests

title: PulseAudio native protocol client
description: Pure TypeScript implementation of the PulseAudio native protocol over Unix socket, using Effect 4.0 idioms. Only the recording subset: connect, auth, list sources, create record stream, receive PCM data as Effect Stream, disconnect. No playback, volume control, sample cache, or module management. Reference implementation in .reference/pulseaudio.js/
design: Module structure under src/pulse/: protocol.ts (TagStruct binary serialization, packet framing), commands.ts (Auth, SetClientName, GetServerInfo, CreateRecordStream, DeleteRecordStream, GetSourceList), client.ts (PulseAudioClient Effect service with socket lifecycle and request/response matching), stream.ts (RecordStream as Effect Stream of Uint8Array), defs.ts (constants, enums). Use @effect/platform Socket for Unix socket communication. Audio format configurable with defaults matching PIE (S16LE, 16kHz, mono).
acceptance_criteria: Can connect to local PulseAudio server, authenticate, list sources, open a recording stream, and receive PCM audio data as an Effect Stream. Gate passes.
notes: Implementation complete for all child tasks. check/lint/test pass for pulse files; full gate is blocked by pre-existing format issues in AGENTS.md, docs/qa.md, .beads/README.md, .beads/metadata.json unrelated to this feature.
close_reason: PulseAudio recording client implemented and gate now passes

title: Protocol constants and type definitions
description: Define PA protocol constants, enums, and types needed for the recording subset. Covers PA_COMMAND enum (only commands we use), PA_TAG enum, PA_SAMPLE_FORMAT, PA_STREAM_DESCRIPTOR, protocol version, cookie length, sentinel values (PA_NO_INDEX, PA_NO_VALUE), socket path defaults, and SampleSpec/ChannelMap types.
design: Single file src/pulse/defs.ts. Use const enums or plain objects. Keep only the subset we need but use the same numeric values as the PA protocol so we stay wire-compatible. Export types for SampleSpec, ChannelMap, and SourceInfo.
acceptance_criteria: All constants match PA native protocol values. Types compile. No runtime deps.
close_reason: Implemented defs.ts constants/types for PulseAudio subset

title: TagStruct binary serialization
description: Implement the TagStruct packet format used by PulseAudio native protocol. This is the binary serialization layer that encodes/decodes typed values (u32, u8, u64, string, bool, arbitrary bytes, sample spec, channel map, proplist, cvolume) into a tagged binary format. Also implement the packet descriptor header (20 bytes: length, channel, offset_hi, offset_lo, flags).
design: File src/pulse/protocol.ts. Use Uint8Array and DataView instead of Node Buffer for Bun compatibility. Implement a writer class (builds packets) and reader class (parses packets). Writer grows buffer dynamically. Reader tracks cursor position. Each value prefixed with a single-byte tag from PA_TAG enum. Packet finalize prepends the 20-byte descriptor header.
acceptance_criteria: Can round-trip all tag types: u8, u32, u64, string, null string, bool, arbitrary, sample spec, channel map, proplist. Unit tests pass for encoding and decoding.
close_reason: Implemented TagStruct serialization + packet framing with tests

title: Command builders for recording subset
description: Implement command packet builders and response parsers for the PA commands needed for recording: AUTH, SET_CLIENT_NAME, GET_SERVER_INFO, GET_SOURCE_INFO_LIST, CREATE_RECORD_STREAM, DELETE_RECORD_STREAM. Each command builds a TagStruct packet with the correct fields and provides a response parser.
design: File src/pulse/commands.ts. Each command is a function that returns a finalized Uint8Array packet. Response parsers are separate functions that take a TagStruct reader and return typed results. Use request tag counter for matching responses. Auth sends protocol version + cookie. CreateRecordStream sends sample spec, channel map, source index, buffer attrs, and boolean flags.
acceptance_criteria: Can build and parse all 6 commands. Response parsers return typed objects matching the PA protocol spec. Unit tests verify packet structure against reference implementation.
close_reason: Implemented command builders/parsers for recording subset

title: PulseAudio client service
description: Effect service that manages the Unix socket connection to PulseAudio server. Handles connection lifecycle, authentication handshake, packet framing (reading 20-byte headers then payload), request/response matching via tag IDs, and dispatching memory block packets to recording streams.
design: File src/pulse/client.ts. PulseAudioClient as an Effect Service with Layer. connect returns Effect that performs auth + set_client_name. Uses @effect/platform Socket for Unix domain socket. Incoming data parsed in a loop: read 20-byte header, extract payload length, read payload, dispatch based on channel (0xFFFFFFFF = command response, otherwise = stream data). Pending requests stored in a Map keyed by tag ID, resolved via Deferred. Scoped resource management: socket closed on scope finalization.
acceptance_criteria: Can connect to local PA server, authenticate, query server info, list sources. Connection properly cleaned up on scope exit. Handles disconnection errors.
close_reason: Implemented PulseAudio client service with socket lifecycle and request matching

title: Recording stream as Effect Stream
description: Implement createRecordStream that returns an Effect.Stream of Uint8Array chunks containing raw PCM audio data. The stream sends CREATE_RECORD_STREAM to PA, receives audio data via memory block packets dispatched by the client, and sends DELETE_RECORD_STREAM on finalization.
design: File src/pulse/stream.ts. createRecordStream takes PulseAudioClient + recording options (sample spec, source index, fragment size). Returns Stream.async or Stream.fromQueue -- client dispatches incoming MemoryBlock packets for the stream's channel into the queue. Stream finalization sends DELETE_RECORD_STREAM. Options have sensible defaults: S16LE, 16000Hz, 1 channel, default source.
acceptance_criteria: Can open a recording stream against the default source, receive audio chunks as Uint8Array, and cleanly close the stream. Audio data is valid PCM matching the requested sample spec.
close_reason: Implemented createRecordStream as Effect Stream with cleanup

title: Integration test with live PulseAudio
description: End-to-end test that connects to a real PulseAudio server, lists sources, opens a recording stream for 1 second, verifies received data is non-empty valid PCM, and cleanly disconnects.
design: File test/pulse.test.ts. Skip if no PA socket available. Test cases: connect and get server info, list sources returns at least one, record 1 second of audio and verify byte count matches expected (sampleRate * channels * bytesPerSample * duration). Use Effect.runPromise with timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes on a machine with PulseAudio running. Test skips gracefully when no PA server is available. Gate passes.
close_reason: Added live PulseAudio integration test with graceful skip
